caseName: Empire State Highway Transportation Ass'n v. United States
caseNameFull: Empire State Highway Transportation Assn., Inc. v. United States
attorneys: Herbert Burstein for petitioner. Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Loevinger, Richard A. Solomon, Robert E. Mitchell and Edward Aptaker for the United States et al., and Mark P. Schlefer and T. S. L. Perlman for American Export Lines, Inc., et al., respondents.

opinions.text: Motion of American Export Lines, Inc., et al. to be named parties respondent granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit denied.
